document: Ashen Vow whole-game rebuild changed-asset inventory
scope: All implementation phases; source-connected and statically inspected, NOT runtime-certified
notes: Snapshot of the uncommitted worktree; no commit/push/reset was performed.
New .uid/.import sidecars are included individually. The user's already-open Godot editor may generate additional sidecars after this snapshot. No imports were invoked by Codex.
No deleted or renamed tracked assets are recorded in this rebuild.
Existing IDs/geographic anchors/movement/camera preserved. 20 prior spells plus 2 unlimited catalyst basics; 10 usable weapon templates.
All runtime, visual, save-failure, audio and performance results remain unverified. See VERIFICATION.txt.
